hits.snippet: # House of Student raises $2M seed to grow AI-driven student housing platform House of Student raises $2M seed to grow AI-driven student housing platform What's the deal? Student accommodation platform House of Student has raised $2 million in seed funding, co-led by Saltwater Sutra and Nirmitsu Ventures. The round combined equity and debt. Who's backing it? Participants include Gautam Verlekar, Bank of New York Mellon managing director Glen Fernandes, former UK India Business Council chief executive Richard McCallum, and Singapore Gulf Bank executive vice-chairman Ali Moosa. Existing investors from Unilodgers also joined. [...] By the numbers: Headquartered in San Francisco with teams across India, the UK, and the Middle East, the company says it runs the world's largest student housing supply network — more than 2.5 million verified rooms across 25-plus countries, including the US, UK, Australia, Canada, New Zealand, the UAE, and Singapore. The signal: At $2 million, this is a modest seed even by early-stage standards, landing in the bottom third of comparable rounds.
